articleTitle: High Efficiency Power Amplifier for IoT Applications: RF Path
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: IoT devices must remain operational for 10 years with one set of batteries. Most power is typically consumed by an RF power amplifier, which is necessary for transmitting data over a wireless radio channel in 5G networks. For this reason, the task of increasing the efficiency of an RF power amplifier is relevant. High efficiency can be achieved by using active element switching modes in combination with “synthetic” amplification methods. This article analyzes the energy characteristics of a Class D switching power amplifier with a filter for two configurations: voltage mode and current mode for various transistor saturation times (Duty Ratio). Based on the analysis of time diagrams, integral equations are written, the solution of which allows us to derive calculation formulas. The results of calculations are presented. It is shown that the mode of working with meanders is most advantageous, while the VMCD circuit should work at τsat≤π, and in the CMCD circuit should work at τsat≥π.

articleTitle: Positioning Performance Requirements Evaluation for Grid Model in Ultra-Dense Network Scenario
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The 5G New Radio beamforming control during active communication sessions can substantially increase spatial multiplexing capabilities in ultra-dense networks (UDN) and is possible with preliminary location estimation of neighboring stations being another radio emission sources (RES). This article discusses grid model scenarios to access 3-dimensional accuracy computation and visualization of RES positioning in UDN. The possibility of spatial separation of neighboring RES is determined on the basis of Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) concentration ellipsoid which indicates location error and its direction. 5G positioning requirements and general case of dense sensor grid model is considered. Urban layout example scenario was simulated and revealed positioning accuracy up to 3 m in 3D UDN model.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network Model Design for Monitoring Wireless Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the most important options for using neural networks in the future will be represented by machine-to-machine communication in the field of wireless communication networks, which will meet the necessary diverse range of requirements that arise when creating and operating networks of this type. Subsequently, the communications network will create a domain for a dedicated slice of the existing physical network. The network slice concept is a logical segment of a working physical network that guarantees a set of necessary States for Quality of Service (QoS). It is also worth noting that they are presented for end-to-end communication with the network core. It is also considered as the development of a neural network model for monitoring the system for telecommunications corporate networks. The applied analysis system is carried out.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Remote Monitoring Human Health System
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Information technology of the Internet of things is actively implemented in all spheres of human life. One of the main directions, in addition to IIoT and Smart City, is Smart healthcare. Wearable devices, including wristbands, not only play an important role in human health monitoring, but also have great potential in driving safety. The article describes the development of a hardware-software complex for monitoring the health status of a vehicle driver, which uses portable devices to control the physiological parameters of a person and transfers data to a mobile terminal or uploads it to a cloud server for data analysis.

articleTitle: Frequency Tuning Range Limitation in Microwave Generators on Bipolar Active Device
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of disturbances occurrence, include the effect of frequency tuning range limitation, in microwave generators is being discussed. This problem is especially actual in design of microwave generators for the board equipment. The frequency tuning range limitation effect mechanism is carried out. We show the specifics of this effect causes in a microwave resonators system specific and we described the effect with frequency generation conditions. The experiments with microwave generators with waveguide resonator were fulfilled and experimental results for generators on bipolar active device are given.

articleTitle: Vehicle to Vehicle Communication: Dedicated Short Range Communication and Safety Awareness
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) Dedicated Short Range Communication (DSRC) is the new communication method which is developed for the data transmission between vehicles in order to improve the efficiency of the traffic flow on roads and to reduce traffic accidents. However, according to the close investigation of this communication protocol, it has been found that this protocol lacks the security from malicious hacking. A new method to improve the security of the DSRC protocol has been developed and presented in this paper. The computer simulation results are included in this paper.

articleTitle: Neural Network Classification of Cardiac Activity Based on Cardiogram Data for Driver Support System
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the use of neural network technologies for predicting humans heart activity within healthcare wireless systems. Developing algorithm could become a part of integrated system of driver support system embedded on board of the automobile. The trained algorithm is a convolutional neural network with memorizing of previous calculations. The model was trained on the original data set and showed poor classification accuracy on classes with a small number of examples. Expanding the number of examples allowed to increase the recognition accuracy of the two weakest classes by 8 and 19 %.

articleTitle: Calibration of a Planar Scanner for Near-Field Antenna Measurements
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The main goal of the work is to increase the near field measurement accuracy of antennas characteristics by performing calibration of planar scanner. This becomes possible when using the phaseless switching method for the diagnostics of amplitude and phase scanning errors. The novelty of the proposed solution lies in the fact that the phase state changing of the channel under calibration is performed without the usage of phase shifters by digital methods only. During the research process a simulation model of the calibration process was developed. That model was shown the convergence of the algorithm for any values of phase and amplitude errors. Special software for automatic estimation of measurement errors was developed. Experimental studies of a planar scanner in an anechoic chamber were carried out. The obtained results turn it possible to reduce the amplitude and phase measurement errors in the process of moving the scanner to values corresponding to the industrial standards of high-end devices.

articleTitle: Reservation Based Joint Servicing of Real Time and Batched Traffic in Inter Satellite Link
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The model for conjoint servicing of real time and batch arrival data streams by a satellite link is constructed. Request flows coming from subscribers for real time servicing are described by Engset model with intensity depending on the type of service. Request flows coming from subscribers for data transmission, follows Poisson model with batch arrivals. The duration of servicing of requests for real time and data transmission has exponential distribution with parameter depending on the type of servicing. The request for real time traffic transmission with some probability depending on the number of busy channels can be refused servicing despite availability of free channels. It allows to reserve transmission capacity for priority data traffic. In the framework of the constructed model, the formal definitions of main performance measures the conjoint traffic transmissions are introduced. These are formulated with help of values of probabilities of model's stationary states. The numerical algorithm of calculation of introduced performance measures by solving the system of state equations using Gauss-Zeidel iterative algorithm is introduced. The proposed model and the results of derived can be used for estimation of the parameters of reservation of transmission capacity of satellite link for given values of quality characteristics and volumes of real time and batched data traffics.

articleTitle: Methods for Increasing the Computational Efficiency of the Algorithm for Calculating the Compensator for Non-Uniformity of the Frequency Response of Analog Filters in a Hybrid Filter Bank
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper describes methods for increasing the computational efficiency of algorithms that determine transfer function of analog filters from hybrid filter bank and calculate the impulse reaction of the compensator, ensuring that the total transfer characteristic of the system approaches the fulfillment of signal perfect reconstruction conditions.

articleTitle: A New Model of Human Respiration for Algorithm Simulation Modeling in Radar Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper aims at designing the advanced simulation model that is able to generate samples similar to human respiration signals typically acquired by a Doppler or Continuous-wave step frequency short-range radar system. The model is based on the continuous non-linear transformation of the mixture of a sine wave with amplitude and frequency modulation and a colored Gaussian noise. Despite not being based on a detailed physiological description of the respiration process, the proposed model can produce samples of respiration signals resembling the signals acquired by a radar with high accuracy. In contrast to the widely-used monoharmonic model, the model does not exhibit strict periodicity that allows researchers to consider it to be an appropriate sample generator for thorough testing procedures performed over existing algorithms of respiration signal detection as well as newly-created ones.

articleTitle: Fractional Power Spectra in Diagnostics of Nonlinear Discrete Lorentz and Chua Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The express diagnostics of multi-mode discrete-nonlinear electronic systems based on the non-harmonic spectra of their signals is considered. A new technique for constructing multidimensional non-harmonic fractional power spectra of signals has been developed. A criterion for choosing the optimal form of basis functions in the non-harmonic spectral analysis of fractal signals of discrete-nonlinear electronic systems is proposed. Multidimensional non-harmonic fractional power spectra of diagnosed discrete-nonlinear Lorentz and Chua systems are proposed and investigated. An approach in the express diagnostics of multimode discrete-nonlinear radio-electronic devices and systems with chaotic dynamics, based on multidimensional fractional power spectra of fractal signals, has been developed.

articleTitle: Web Application Development for Biometric Identification System Based on Neural Network Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the structural analysis of the developed biometric identification complex with a description of the architecture of the complex and its hardware and software components, design and development of web applications operators, as well as performance testing of important modules of the web application. Biometric identification complex under development can be applied in various spheres where access control to various important parts is required, for example in airports and its control zones. This work was supported by an internal MTUCI grant.

articleTitle: Wideband Signals Dispersion Distortions Optimum Tracking Compensator Based On Digital Filter Banks Using Farrow Filters
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article proposes a computationally effective scheme of the dispersion distortions compensation device, based on a filter bank using the Farrow filter. The possibility of constructing a tracking compensator for dispersion distortions of broadband signals when transmitting them through the ionospheric channel is considered. The tracking compensator allows the estimation of dispersion distortions and their compensation. The results of simulation of the proposed algorithms are presented: the obtained estimate and the true value of the frequency dispersion parameters.

articleTitle: Reducing Distortion when Applying the Rational Choice of the Digital Conversion Method
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: When converting signals into digital form, certain distortions (errors) appear in these signals associated with discretization and quantization. This circumstance is taken into account when developing appropriate methods for analog-to-digital conversion in order to ensure established quality requirements. However, in addition to this, distortion also occurs due to the random influence of interference introducing errors into the digital signal. As a result, the quality of the signal received during transmission and recovery may not meet the established requirements. In order to minimize distortions arising due to errors in the digital signal, it is necessary to study the influence of these random factors on the transmitted signal, to explore ways to rationally choose digital display methods taking into account transformations in various metric spaces. The article analyzes the error matrix and the code distance matrix of the binary code, calculates the total number of distortions in the transformations of various metric spaces. The values that determine the distance between the original messages and the given metric of the Euclidean space are calculated. These values will allow you to establish a correspondence between messages and code combinations of the binary code, for which the distance is already set in another space (Hamming). Also, the article suggests minimizing distortions if the minimum distances of one metric space are associated with the minimum distances of another metric space. In addition, the study revealed limitations on this minimization.

articleTitle: Interactive Built Environment in Shaping Users Orientation And Navigation in Space
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Interactive properties allow the space to participate in social relationship, becoming the driving force of people's communication with the space. Interactive environment becomes a vehicle behind social interaction between the users in real time, creating unique common experience and navigating them through space. A full scale prototype is used to examine fundamental and applied questions of sensorial response integration into spatial communication between people and interactive built environment as a proof of concept. The paper examines the effect of interactive space stimuli and the visitors' responsiveness to signals from the space in order to shape their behaviour within the space and find the most effective ways of communication between visitors and interactive environment. Performed tests and observations allowed to assess the new qualities of interactive environment in shaping visitors experience and behaviour within the space on both personal and social levels, linking the conclusions to cybernetic background of the paper.

articleTitle: Application of Gaussian Function for Modeling Two-Frequency Radiation from Addressed FBG
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses a possibility of modeling responses of addressed fiber Bragg structures (AFBS) using the normal Gauss distribution function. The presented study is motivated by the fact that for the reliable operation of the microwave photonic measurement system, based on the use of address structures with two identical narrow-band bandwidth responses (2λ-FBG), it is necessary to ensure that a bandwidth of an inclined filter covers the operating range of the AFBS. Since this filter is necessary for estimating a shift of a central wavelength of the AFBS by determining a change in amplitudes of oscillations at a photodetector, which allows measurements of various physical fields without the use of expensive interrogators.

articleTitle: Method of Achieving Interoperability of Applied Software Based on the Analysis of Their Data
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To get the most benefit from using an application program, it is necessary that it can freely exchange data with the programs surrounding it. To achieve this goal, a method has been developed to achieve the interoperability of application software based on the analysis of their data, using the unique frequency characteristics of the data to identify them, which are necessary for their exchange.

articleTitle: Designing WI-FI Wireless Networks with High Density of Subscriber Service
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper discusses issues related to the design of highly loaded wireless Wi-Fi data networks and their segments in the context of the development of modern information and communication technologies, leading to a constant increase in the number of connected devices and, as a result, to an increase in network load and increase the density of customer service. The optimal approaches to the design of such networks are considered, in particular, the coverage area of access points, the drop in speed when connecting a large number of users, as well as the impact on the functioning of the network of various kinds of interference are analyzed.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach to the Regression Problem in Forest Fires Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Machine learning procedures are used in almost humans' life areas: recommendations systems for online-services, self-driving cars, machine translation systems and so on. But machine learning tasks complexity and importance are grown up and solutions based on a single algorithm can have bad quality. The complex approach was developed for burned area estimating on the forest fires detection problem. The developed approach was tested on the data of Montensinho park. In this paper developed approach is compared with classic regression algorithms and its advantages are shown. The significantly better quality of the proposed solution is demonstrated.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Analysis of Data Risk Management Methods for Personal Data Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article describes the problem of assessing the information quality risk tolerance using semantic models for high-loaded information and communication systems for personal data protection. The article is devoted to current topics - information risk, which plays an important role in all areas of human activity. The most popular risk management methods are considered, their features, characteristics and comparison among themselves are given. Attention is paid to some problems of risk management, such as risk assessment and the construction of a threat assessment model.

articleTitle: Prospects for Applications of Small-Sized Antennas on Flexible Substrates
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, an overview of application of antennas on flexible substrates is presented. Analysis of possible using this type of structures in areas military, industrial, medical, fashion electronics, occupation of safety and health, is showed. The problems of using small-sized antennas with flexible substrates for everyday use are also considered.

articleTitle: Polarization Mode Dispersion Effects on Signal Quality and Compensation Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: With the ever-increasing bandwidth demand, high-speed optical systems are currently widely used to transmit various traffic over long distances. The main direction of development of optical communication systems is associated with the increase in the information transmission rate. However, the performance of long-haul high-speed optical systems is severely affected by linear and nonlinear transmission impairments, such as chromatic dispersion, polarization mode dispersion and nonlinear phase noise. In this paper the effects of the polarization mode dispersion on the system performance and its effects along with chromatic dispersion have been evaluated, and compensation methods have been proposed.

articleTitle: A Security Risk Model for Online Banking System
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: We are living in an era, where the security of our data has become a huge issue. The services of cyber are the most entertaining and time-saving things in one's life. Though, people save their data on the cloud, which has been managed by the cyber. Cyber-security plays an important role in this matter. This is the open challenge for the security because many intruders are there who can attack the data and hack the details of the user by the server. If we will see around, then we will find many cases which include cyber-crime. This has become a very genuine concern to secure our datasets which are available on the cloud. Our research includes the security of the datasets which will include intruder detection that can be occurring anywhere on the earth. This has become very important to protect the data from intruders, for this intruder detection should be the most important key to get identified. If we don't know who is the intruder, then how we will get to know who is stealing the data which has been secured by using much biometric security, fingerprints, passwords, OTPs etc. intruder detection has become very important, especially on mobile objects - airplanes, ships, etc. As we know the problem then only we are able to find the solution. To prevent this, we are using the methods from machine learning, biometric recognition, data learning or hybrid methods. These are going to be the handle of the system that can help to secure the data from intruders by using best optimization techniques to get precise data. We proposed a model for the banking system, whereby using biometric impressions and digital signatures to make every transaction possible by bank's customer. This proposes the security for the Smart Online Banking System (SOBS) by using the biometric prints, it can become more secure and reduces a lot of threats can be made by an intruder.

articleTitle: Research of an Ultra-Wideband Distributed Amplifier Based on Field-Effect Transistors
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The main tasks are discussed in this paper such as in the construction of transmitters of digital television broadcasting, in particular the task of constructing a universal preamplifier, which can be used regardless of any particular channel. Distributed amplifiers permit to build wide-range power amplifiers with constant gain in the preset frequency range. The main feature of the construction of distributed amplifiers is using input and output capacitances of amplifying device in the artificial transmission lines. The main advantages and disadvantages of this type of amplifiers are presented in the paper. The method of calculation of distributed amplifier for UHF and the research its energetic characteristics are discussed in the paper. The further research tasks for this type of amplifier are given.

articleTitle: Synchronous Methods of BPSK Signal Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The description and research results of characteristics of the patented by the authors BPSK signal shaper based on the globally linearized synchronization system (GLSS) are presented. GLSS is a phase locked loop (PLL) system with an unconventional structure optimized for speed in transient operation mode in accordance with the Pontryagin maximum principle. The structural algorithm of shaper provides the implementation of binary phase manipulation by the method of sequentially synchronizing system at neighboring points of stable equilibrium located on the phase portrait of GLSS, in contrast to traditional PLL, with a period of π radians. With using simulation program methods illustrate the possibilities of generating a BPSK signal directly at a carrier frequency of 6.4 GHz, with an information transfer rate of 300 Mbit/s. The obtained results indicate the promise of using a synchronous BPSK signal shaper based on GLSS in applications requiring high values of information transfer rates and signals shaping in the microwave range at the operating frequency of the infocommunication system, under conditions when the programmable element base is no longer applicable

Author Keywords: signals shaping directly in the microwave range of the operating frequencies

articleTitle: Combined Approach to SSDF-Attacks Mitigation in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Cognitive radio systems aim to solve the issue of spectrum scarcity through implementation of dynamic spectrum management and cooperative spectrum access. However, the structure of such systems introduced unique types of vulnerabilities and attacks, one of which is spectrum sensing data falsification attack (SSDF). In such attacks malicious users provide incorrect observations to the fusion center of the system, which may result in severe quality of service degradation and interference for licensed users. In this paper we investigate this type of attacks and propose a combined approach to their mitigation. On the first step a reputational method is used to isolate the initially untrustworthy nodes, on the second step specialized q-out-of-m fusion rule is utilized to mitigate the remains of attack. In this paper we present theoretical analysis of the proposed combined method.

articleTitle: Isolation of Interfering Wave Components in a Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Results of simulation of reception of multipath waves by phased antenna array with controlled polarisation characteristic, having possibility of rotation in plane of front of falling wave and change of position of this plane, are presented. It is shown that the orientation of the antenna, which minimizes transient distortions in the transfer of beams to partial frequencies, can be realized by determining parameters of polarization ellipses of all components of the multipath signal, and the possibility of such determination is shown. The reported study was funded by RFBR, project number 19-29-06055

articleTitle: The Method of Representing Grayscale Images in Pseudo Color Using Equal-Contrast Color Space
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: There are many applications, including, for example, Earth remote sensing systems based on satellites or UAVs, which receive low-contrast images with a large dynamic range. Visual analysis of such data is complicate due to psychophysiological limitations, therefore, coloring of such images in pseudo color is used. In this paper, we propose optimization of the process of converting images into pseudo color. To ensure the equal distinguishability of the shades of gray, regardless of the brightness of the recognizable detail of the original image, it is proposed to display the gradations of gray by converting them into pseudo color obtained by traversing the grid in an equal-contrast color space developed at the Department of Television and Audio Broadcasting of MTUCI. The work contains a selection of options for such a traverse of the color space with a fixed brightness value. Thus, the modulation of the brightness value can be further used to add additional information to the resulting image in arbitrary colors. The report presents the results of evaluating the effectiveness of the proposed conversion method in the form of a completely subjective assessment, as well as in the variant of visual determination of the coefficient of visibility of the brightness difference in a specially prepared test image.

articleTitle: Spectral Efficiency and Information Transfer Rate Over Optical Fibers in Spatial Parallelism
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Spatial parallelism contribution to optical fibers spectral efficiency and to signal transfer rate is being estimated. Parallelism multiplier system parameter is introduced. Using this parameter analytical expressions are constructed to determine the optical fibers spectral efficiency and information transfer rate. Examples of spatial parallelism of optical signal transmission in few-mode and multicore fibers are given.

articleTitle: Cyclostationary Evaluation of Voltage Crosstalk Between PCB's Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Theoretical and experimental evaluation of the crosstalk between transmission lines of the printed circuit boards (PCB) induced by the electromagnetic interference emitted by the random signals with cyclostationary properties are presented. The quantitative analysis of the crosstalk between two adjacent lines was evaluated by the bit error ratio (BER) of the communication link. The interference signal measured by the real time digital oscilloscope was characterized as a cyclostationary stochastic process. The cyclic averaging of the induced interference reveals the instantaneous periodic power corresponding to the variance of the probability density function (PDF). The PDF was obtained from the amplitude histograms constructed for each instant of time over the bit duration. Experimental evaluation of the BER for the communication link influenced by the voltage crosstalk was performed.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Information Security
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article analyzes the possibilities of using artificial intelligence technologies to ensure information security. The advantages of using machine learning for processing information security events are shown. A review of modern commercial information protection products that use artificial intelligence technologies is conducted.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis Efficiency Optical Telecommunication Networks on the Basis Optical WDM and DWDM Technologies
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The performance characteristics of optical transport communication networks based on the technology of spectral separation of channels using a transmitting and receiving optical module (TOM and ROM) are analyzed. The performance indicators of optical transport networks based on optical WDM & DWDM technologies are investigated and a method for calculating an optical signal transmission system (OSTS) is proposed. This method takes into account the principles of spectral separation of optical channels and operation algorithms, the functioning scheme of the studied fiber-optic transmission systems, as well as information security indicators of fiber-optic communication lines using quantum cryptography. Based on the calculation method, important analytical expressions were obtained that evaluate the performance indicators of multiservice optical telecommunication networks based on the FN (Future Network) architectural concept using SDN (Software Defined Network) technology.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transport Technologies in “Smart” Cities
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the review of modern solutions for creating intelligent transport management systems, which are an integral part of the infrastructure of “smart” cities. The paper considers the development of intelligent transport systems in the context of the formation of modern smart cities and the mutually beneficial use of advanced technologies for the benefit of society and the state. The most important advantages of smart transport systems and the challenges faced by society and authorities when implementing them in everyday life are identified. The most promising technologies for improving the transport infrastructure of smart cities are defined.

articleTitle: Application of Fast Transformations in Galois Fields to Increase Efficiency of Radio Channel Resources Using
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The object of consideration is radio systems using special correlation properties of code sequences for the simultaneous execution of various information functions, in particular, measuring the motion parameters of aerospace objects group and transmitting a variety of information. The subject of the analysis are procedures for the construction and processing of encoded signals, ensuring the effective compositing of information functions. The purpose of the analysis - identification of classes and characterization of code sequences, devices for their construction and processing, capable of compositing information functions and having the property of adaptation to the rapid change in the code sequences structure. The solution is based on the principles and mathematical models developed by the authors: the principle of fast transformations in Galois fields, an algebraic representation model, and the structure of fast delay acquisition devices for a subclass of sequences. The article is devoted to the search and evaluation of encoding methods characteristics, the method of compositing information functions with the minimum mutual influence of signal processing processes on each other, identifying encoding and decoding rules that can quickly adapt signal processing devices to changing encoding parameters. The results of the work will be useful to developers of various information and communication systems that are resistant to signal-like noises.

articleTitle: Blockchain Models to Improve the Service Security on Board Communications
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The present article introduces a definition of Blockchain, describes services implemented by this technology and the field of its application. The authors identify the main technical characteristics and their features associated with data transmission through the network. This article provides the operation principles of Blockchain technology and a block structure. The authors determine the network scheme working with blockchain transactions and the dependence of network characteristics on application parameters. The security aspects of data transmission within Blockchain technology are analyzed as well. The types of network attacks and Blockchain devices are listed in the article. In addition, the authors propose a Blockchain traffic identification model that allows discrediting the existing security mechanisms of this technology and makes services vulnerable to these attacks. Furthermore, the article offers recommendations on hiding the Blockchain traffic profile, which will significantly complicate its identification on the data network.

articleTitle: Prediction of Autonomous Objects Position Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of using neural networks for building a vehicle control system is considered in this article. The system includes constructing a safe motion path. The possibility of obtaining information received from global and local sensors of the object as input data is considered. This system is proposed for forecasting position of autonomous object taking into account mutual position relative to other participants of movement. Neural network is proposed to minimize functionality characterizing motion costs and its safety taking into account reconstruction.

articleTitle: Modern Satellite Solutions for Internet Broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to a review of the prospects for the development of the Internet broadcasting as a medium for the distribution of media in the future. In particular, the possibilities of using satellite Internet broadcasting for broadcasting mass communications around the world were examined. It is analyzed how information protection technologies for mass communications on the Internet broadcasting will develop, what will change significantly and where will humanity lead in the coming decades. The possibility of using artificial intelligence and neural networks to combat fake news in the media is considered. The advantages and disadvantages of applying new technologies in mass communications, the feasibility of their implementation and other aspects of their practical application in the near future are compared. Conclusions are drawn about the possibility of using satellite Internet broadcasting and similar solutions being developed as tools for disseminating media and mass communications.

articleTitle: Recognition of Analog Signals of a Given Shape Using Continuous Processors
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the use of analogue neural processors to solve the problem of isolating a periodic radio signal from interference. The development goal is to achieve high performance hardware recognition of signals by trained neuro-like devices. It is proposed to perform signal isolation from interference without its digital conversion.

articleTitle: Training of Specialists in On-Board Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to improving the quality of management of an educational organization by automating personalized data collection, storage and ranking in the preparation of specialists in the on-Board communication systems. The authors have developed a module of the university's corporate system - an electronic portfolio of students, which implements a multi-criteria optimization method for calculating students' ratings based on the collected and stored data. The object of the study is multicriteria ranking methods. The subject of the research is the automated calculation of the student rating in the electronic portfolio. The aim of the study is to develop tools for collecting, storing and processing data on individual student achievements and the implementation of a mathematical method of multicriteria optimization for ranking students based on portfolio data. The practical significance of the study is to provide a tool for effective management of the learning process. Method and toolkit. A prototype of the module of the corporate system of the university “Electronic Portfolio” based on the developed configuration in “1C: Enterprise 8.3” is presented. For the ranking of students in the module for data analysis, a special case of the method of ranking alternatives is implemented - pairwise comparison according to their relative importance, using a unified scale of relations. Results. The authors described the scheme of functioning of is “Electronic portfolio”, showed the scheme of interaction of processes on formation of portfolio, presented the scheme of business processes at calculation of an individual rating. A fragment of the sample on which the performance of the multi-criteria optimization block was checked is shown. The criteria taking part in calculations and the rule of selection of alternatives for finding the optimal solution are de-scribed. Discussion and Conclusion. The paper presents the results of the IP block on ranking the list of students. The results of the calculations coincide with the practical results.

articleTitle: Radio Monitoring of Wireless Networks Using LoRa Data Transmission Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern trends in the development of infocommunication systems and networks include the penetration of digital technologies in all spheres of human activity, the increase in the amount of information circulating in telecommunication networks, the expansion of the variety of information sources, the increase in their mobility and the integration of telecommunication systems both at the hardware and software level and at the level of services provided. In this regard, the tasks of ensuring electromagnetic compatibility of various radio interfaces, the solution of which is based on monitoring the congestion of the radio frequency range, are becoming increasingly urgent. The article discusses monitoring issues in wireless networks to identify information systems operating in the “subnoise channel” on the example of IoT networks based on LoRa technology. LoRa uses broadband radio signals, the reception of which can be carried out in the range from 0 to 20 dB below the level, so traditional monitoring tools based on the allocation of “strong” narrow-band radio signals cannot be used to solve the task.

articleTitle: Improved Accuracy Intrusive Method for Speech Quality Evaluation Based on Consideration of Intonation Impact
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the problem of the effect of intonation in speech transmitted over communication networks on the results of intrusive methods for assessing quality. It is determined that a change in intonation makes changes in the parameters of the speech signal identical to communication networks. Based on the analysis of the features of the functioning of methods for assessing the quality of speech transmission, their classification by the criterion of intonation influence is proposed. The principles of perception by users of complex composite numbers, as well as the mechanism and causes of the occurrence of perception errors are investigated.

articleTitle: Methods of Laboratory Testing of Radiometrics of Space Monitoring Systems for Mobile Objects
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article proposes a methodology for verifying the operability and compliance with regulatory documents of radio beacon of the space monitoring system of moving objects Argos. This technique is based on many years of experience in the development of such radio beacon. In addition, the graphs necessary for the analysis of the output signal are presented, among them the graphs of phase change, power and spectral characteristics, etc.

articleTitle: Object-Oriented Representation of Mixed Models Knowledge in the Design of Electronic Devices in CAD Electra
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: At present days a promising direction is the development of information management systems design, allowing to describe the subject area in the form of a set objects. The purpose of this paper is to consider representation models knowledge in expert systems and highlighting the benefits of using object-based -approximate representation of knowledge about the design area radio device. This paper outlines the principles of construction object-oriented knowledge base management systems that would be compatible with existing programming languages with respect to structures representations of managed knowledge and would provide opportunities to integrate them into expert systems operating on the basis of the concept of open systems. It is proved that the most optimal is the separation of knowledge and meta-knowledge complex mixed types resulting from inheritance. At the same time, internal representation of complex objects formed as a result of inheritance, looks like inheritance chains. When working with complex this system automatically searches special links, allowing you to perform operations according to the SQL standard.

articleTitle: The Choice of Optical Fiber with the Best Transmission Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The introduction of 5G technology, the increasing demand for the Internet of things, and the growing demand for multimedia applications that need to increase the speed of optical fiber transmission. To provide and implement coherent systems of 100–400 Gb/s, optical fibers with better performance are required. The work considers the transfer characteristics of various optical fibers. In conclusion, based on the calculation and analysis, recommendations are given for choosing an optical fiber that has the best transfer characteristics among single-mode optical fibers.

articleTitle: Estimation of Efficiency of Video Signals Processing algorithms in Television Cameras when Transmitting Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: IP video cameras and camera modules are widely used, including in on-board equipment, due to the lack of reference to television standards for image decomposition and interface flexibility, and they are coming to replace solutions based on analog, SDI family and other standards. On-board systems commonly control objects whose position changes over time. IP cameras, due to the applied video processing algorithms, usually transmit the image of static objects with the best quality. Methods of measuring parameters and video cameras involve the use of test tables, thus, the degradation of the quality of time-varying scenes is not controlled. A method for controlling the quality of transmission of moving objects is proposed. Along with subjective assessment, a methodology for obtaining objective parameters characterizing the degree of degradation of a moving image and threshold values of the speed of movement of objects and their illumination was developed.

articleTitle: Metods Ensuring the Secure of Software for Intelligent Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article deals problems with the security of software for Intelligent Transport systems that form the basis of national digital economies and critical information infrastructures. An extended system of software security criteria has been proposed, issues of confidence in its security have been considered. A method of software security is proposed, based on the integration of information security requirements and technological independence of software. An example of the implementation of the proposed methodology for ensuring the security of digital economy objects and critical information infrastructures is presented. An example of the implementation of the proposed methodology for ensuring the security of digital economy objects and critical information infrastructures is presented.

articleTitle: Determining Channels Number in the Digital Filter Bank for the Wideband Signals Dispersion Distortion Compensation
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to determining the parameters of a dispersion distortion compensation device. Dispersion compensator device is based on digital filter bank, and main parameter needed to determine is number of channels. The article presents some theoretical results which bind a channel number and a quality of non-linear phase correction.

articleTitle: QPSK Signal Generation Based on Globally Linearized Synchronization System
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents a description of the quadrature phase shift keying (QPSK) signal shaping methodology based on the structure of a globally linearized synchronization system (GLSS). The results of simulation modeling of the QPSK-GLSS shaper, which performs the modulation process directly at the operating frequency in the microwave range, under conditions when the use of a programmable element base becomes ineffective, are presented. To synthesize the QPSK signal, the structure of the GLSS is supplemented with special control units that transform the phase portrait in such a way that the points of stable equilibrium of the system are located in steps equal to π/2 radians. The first control unit implements static shifts of the locations of the system stable equilibrium points equal to ±π/4 along the phase axis of the system phase portrait, depending on the polarity of the control signal. The second unit of binary control implements alternate synchronization of the GLSS system at two points of stable equilibrium located at a distance of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\pi}$</tex> radians from each other. Joint combinations of control actions give a complete set of phase shifts of the system output signal relative to the reference oscillation, which corresponds to the QPSK manipulation: [-π/4; π/4; 3π/4; 5π/4]. The dynamic characteristics of the QPSK-GLSS shaper (modulator) are illustrated by the results of simulation when generating a signal directly at a frequency of 6.4 GHz and a data transfer rate equal to 300 Mbit/s.

articleTitle: Modeling of Spectrum Response of Addressed FBG-Structures in Load Sensing Bearings
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work focuses on the mathematical modeling of the optical spectrum of the addressed fiber Bragg structure. The usage of addressed fiber Bragg structures (AFBS) allows to eliminate the disadvantages of the strain sensors based on traditional fiber Bragg grating, such as high costs of the optical interrogators required for their probing. This enables the application of AFBS-based strain sensors for the strain measurement of the outer ring of the automotive load sensing bearings. The modelling approach uses Lorentz function to describe the spectrum of the transparency window of the addressed structure with two symmetrical π-phase shifts. The approach allowed to define the influence of the width of transparency window on the amplitude and the full width at half maximum of the address frequency spectral component of the electric signal at the photodetector.

articleTitle: Prediction of Moving Bottleneck for Safety Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Based on simulations in the framework of Kerner's three-phase traffic theory, we present a methodology for the prediction of a moving bottleneck (MB) with the use of a small share of probe vehicles (floating car data - FCD) randomly distributed in traffic flow. The methodology of MB prediction can be used by automated driving vehicles for speed harmonization, collision avoidance that should increase traffic safety and comfort.

articleTitle: Radiation-Resistant Optical Cable for Space Technology Objects
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problems of import substitution, the expansion of the electronic component base of Russian industry in recent years are increasingly heard in the circles of developers of technical solutions. The cable industry, in particular, the development and production of optical communication cables, was no exception. The main problem here is the manufacture of optical fiber with the necessary properties on the basis of Russian enterprises without the use of imported materials. This is a problem for the reason that, due to the lack of the necessary materials and technological base for the production of specialized fibers, it is easier and cheaper to purchase imported optical fiber than to establish production of your own. However, specialists of JSC “VNIIKP”, together with Institute of Radio Engineering and Electronics named after V.A. Kotelnikov of the Russian Academy of Sciences and JSC «Concern «Central Research Institute «Electropribor», developed and first put into serial production a radiation-resistant single-mode optical fiber operating at two wavelengths, on the basis of which an optical cable with the corresponding properties was made. The cable is miniature, its outer diameter is 3.0 mm, weight 8.5 kg / km, and is designed to provide communication at space technology facilities. The extended temperature range of application, resistance to low atmospheric pressure, ionizing radiation and various mechanical stresses, is confirmed by the results of relevant tests and allows you to use this cable in accordance with the intended use.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Accuracy of Determining the Coordinates and Speed of Small-Size UAV of a Multi-Position Radar with Omnidirectional Antenna Elements
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, unmanned aerial vehicles are actively used in various fields of human activity: terrain monitoring, cartography, cargo delivery, military affairs, etc. The concept of “smart city” involves the widespread use of various UAVs to solve a wide class of problems. Unauthorized use of UAVs can lead to threats to the functioning of the “smart city”, since the control system of unmanned vehicles of the “smart city” does not take into account the presence of UAVs-violators and, accordingly, is not able to quickly respond to emerging threats. The solution to this problem may be the creation of a global airspace monitoring system within the framework of the “smart city”. One of the most effective methods of airspace control is the use of radar. These funds are all-weather and can provide round-the-clock control of the space. Currently, most research in this area is aimed at developing new highly efficient radar systems based on antennas with phased array antennas with control of the direction of radiation of signals in a given area of space. At the same time, such complexes are not able to provide simultaneous control of various areas of space, which significantly reduces the effectiveness of their use in solving detection problems. Another promising area is the use of spatially separated low-power transmitting devices emitting an ensemble of broadband orthogonal radio signals, and radio receiving systems with omnidirectional antenna elements. This article is devoted to questions of assessing the potential accuracy of determining the coordinates and speed of small UAVs of a multi-position radar with omnidirectional antenna elements. As a result of mathematical modeling, estimates were obtained of the potential accuracy of measuring the plane coordinates and the UAV height for various topologies of the placement of transceiver modules and their number and base size. It is shown that when using a signal with a spectrum width of 10 MHz and the number of transmitting and receiving points equal to 5 within the boundaries of the region of location of the receiving and transmitting points, it is possible to measure plane coordinates with an accuracy of no worse than 1 m at the base of 5 km and 50 m at the base of 10 km. Expanding the spectrum of the probe signal to 100 MHz, ceteris paribus, leads to an increase in accuracy to 0.1-0.2 m at the base of 5 km, and 1-2 m at the base of 10 km. In the simulation, the power of the transmitting device was 5 W, the pulse duration was 0.1023 ms, the number of accumulated pulses was 8, and the ESR of the target was 0.1 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 0.01 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The reported study was funded by RFBR, project number 19-29-06006\19.

articleTitle: The Influence of Flexible Bending on the Electrodynamic Characteristics of RFID Tags
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we study the effect of the bending effect on the electrodynamic characteristics of the RFID tag. The simulation of RFID tags with a more complex topology was carried out. An antenna based on a circular meander line was taken as the basis of the tag and its reduced model was presented. The results of the study allow us to see the negative changes in the electrodynamic characteristics during flexible deformations. This will allow to take into account during design and production the features of the behavior of RFID tags during operation (transportation, wear, etc.) in order to increase the likelihood of reading tags under adverse operating conditions.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Rheological Deformations of Asphalt Concrete
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The construction of high-quality asphalt concrete pavement is an actual direction in the development of the sphere of road construction. The deformation of asphalt is due to low crack resistance, causing cracking and tearing of the coating. This deformation reduces road safety. A theoretical model is proposed that combines well-known rheological models, as well as models developed on the basis of experimental data.

articleTitle: Fractional Power Spectrums in Diagnostics of On-Board Electronic Equipment of Monitoring, Measuring and Temperature Regulating Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this work, the development and research of the method and means of technical diagnostics of electronic equipment of the on-board monitoring, measuring and regulating temperature systems with thermocouple sensors according to fractional power spectra of signals were performed. The physical processes that cause typical malfunctions of low-frequency onboard electronic equipment with thermocouple sensors are investigated. Peculiarities of non-harmonic spectral analysis of signals and diagnostics of low-frequency electronic equipment of on-board systems for monitoring, measuring and regulating temperatures systems by fractional power spectra of signals are considered.

articleTitle: An approach of DOA-Estimation Accuracy Improving via Conformal Antenna Arrays with Directional Emitters
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) for calculating errors and accuracy of direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation is discussed for a number of planar waves arriving on an antenna array. The exact expression for the Cramer-Rao lower bound for the DOA-estimation variance calculation depending on the antenna directivity and the geometry is presented. The obtained exact equation shows the most important factors that the direction-of-arrival estimation accuracy is dependent on. A technique of obtaining antenna arrays with optimal directional elements locations is proposed. Those arrays allow increasing DOA estimation accuracy by several times.

articleTitle: Dependability and Quality Satellite Telecommunication Equipment Improving at the Production Stage
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents the urgent problem of improving the developed satellite telecommunication equipment reliability and quality. An analysis of the approaches used in the Russian Federation and the United States to assess the “production quality factor” is made, that directly affects the dependability and quality of the telecommunication equipment. Particular criteria are developed to evaluate the efficiency of the quality management system at the enterprises. Recommendations for the implementation of the developed criteria in the mathematical model for assessing the “production quality coefficient” for the failures category related to the systems management process factor are given.

articleTitle: A Method of Constructing Multifunctional Satellite Navigation System, Monitoring and Management Using Ground-Based Transmitter / Receiver Points
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Improving the accuracy characteristics of consumers working on the signals of satellite radio navigation systems GLONASS/GPS is provided by the ground equipment of functional additions using local control and correction stations (LCCS) based on the differential mode of operation. Currently, various types of differential systems have been developed and put into operation, and relevant regulatory documents have been developed. Along with these structures, a method of constructing a spatially distributed differential system is possible, in which the satellite equipment of consumers connected by data transmission lines with the onboard satellite equipment placed on the controlled object is placed on the ground receiving topo-connected points. The method provides the formation of high-precision information based on the principle of relative coordination to control the movement of the object directly on Board (navigation mode) or on the Ground with the transfer of control commands on Board the object (mode of observation and motion control). The method of construction of such system, algorithms of information processing on the example of procedures of landing of the aircraft is considered. The proposed method provides the creation of relatively inexpensive and small-sized equipment. The system, built according to the proposed method, can be used independently or when combined with other existing means where there is no zone of action of LCCS. It is of interest in solving the following tasks: control of landing of unmanned aerial vehicles, control of the landing process of small aircraft, control of the landing process of helicopters at heliports, control of ground unmanned vehicles. The proposed method provides prerequisites for the implementation of control procedures of aircraft without the use of traditional rangefinder and goniometer systems and means of short-range radio navigation.

articleTitle: Compact Highly Selective Microstrip Filters with Folded Hairpin Resonators
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we study the possibilities to significantly reduce the dimensions of the microstrip filters structures on co-directional hairpin resonators and at the same time to increase their frequency selectivity. It is shown that in these structures it is possible to form a large number (P = 2N) of attenuation poles at finite frequencies, which makes it possible to discharge the spurious passband spectrum up to the third harmonic. Moreover, the mechanisms of the formation, splitting, joining, and control of the attenuation poles position on the frequency axis are studied in order to ensure the required attenuation level in specified stopbands.

Author Keywords: control of the working attenuation poles

articleTitle: Design Features of the On-Board Complex for Image Recognition Tasks in Driver Assistance Systems (DAS)
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This research is focused on analysis of modern methods of detecting and recognizing objects in the transport area. An active monitoring method for detecting vehicles on video stream is proposed and the requirements for the hardware part for effective detection in real time are determined

articleTitle: Mathematical Modelling of Infrastructure as a Service
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The relevance of developing models and research methods for resource as well as computational justification of IaaS design solutions is shown. Based on the results of the analysis of IaaS deployment models and the selected dynamic bit traffic model, a model of resource provision for IaaS services is obtained. It was determined and formalized scientific problem of estimating the number of virtual connections IaaS, the results of which received a new optimization model of the system “sources - boundary nodes” IaaS and developed a method of covering areas to calculate the total number of virtual connections IaaS. The obtained scientific results can be used as a basis for automating the computational justification of multi-variant IaaS design solutions at the pre-project stage.

articleTitle: Increasing the Efficiency of Using Redundant Optical Fibers in Cables Operated in Hard-to-Reach Areas
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The ability of a communication network to perform the required functions, while maintaining the values of all its parameters under certain conditions for a given time, is one of the main tasks in design, construction and operation of communication lines. The most vulnerable elements of a communication line are optical fibers. Their damage leads to downtime lines or unacceptably low quality of communication. To ensure reliable operation of the communication network, the impact of damage of the optical fibers on the operability of the communication line should be reduced. Structural, technological and operational solutions may be insufficient to improve reliability characteristics or maintain them at the required level, then applied redundancy of optical fibers by introducing into the structure of the optical cable additional (reserve) optical fibers that are redundant in relation to the minimum necessary to perform the specified functions under certain operating conditions of the communication line for a given time. The issues of optical fibers redundancy in cables laid in hard-to-reach places, primarily under water, were considered earlier in our articles. In this article, we consider a way to increase the efficiency of using redundant fibers in optical or hybrid cables, which can also be used on ships and submarines, access to which is difficult or impossible.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Information Transmission in the Troposphere Communication Line
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The adaptive method of increasing the bandwidth in the transmission of information in the tropospheric communication line is considered. It is shown that if the pulses of the information sequence are frequency modulated, then changing the frequency modulation parameters for each symbol according to an individual law, it is possible to group the pulses reflected from different layers of the troposphere in the receiver. The quasi-coherent addition of grouped pulses allows to increase the energy efficiency of the tropospheric communication line and, accordingly, the bandwidth and noise immunity of information transmission channels.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Dispersion Distortions of Transionospheric Communication Channels when Total Electron Content Measurements are Corrupted with Stochastic Error
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper addresses the problem of mitigation of dispersion distortions in transionospheric satellite communication channels with the use of the data on the propagation medium obtained from global navigation systems. Distortions mitigation is performed by a correction device that operates in the following modes: compensation for dispersion, channel sounding, equalizer training. In addition to this, the influence of stochastic errors that corrupts the total electron content (TEC) measurements on the dispersion correction was considered. The full-scale experiments carried out in Yoshkar-Ola allowed to produce daily variations in the total electron content, frequency dispersion parameters and channel lifetime with the use of data from the GLONASS / GPS satellite systems.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Waveguide-Optical Analog-to-Digital Converter for Ultra-High Speed Systems of Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The possibility of synthesis of ultra-high speed of waveguide-optical analog-to-digital converter (further - ADC) providing conversion of analog information into digital in gigahertz range is considered. The functional scheme of the waveguide-optical ADC containing technologically well-developed optical elements is given, the principle of operation is described in detail. The possibility of increasing the speed of the ADC to potentially possible for optical data processing schemes is shown.

articleTitle: The Use of Various Input Data in the Design of Public Transport Route Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the features and stages of the formulation and solution of the problem of building an effective route network in a large city. The article describes the necessary source data to solve this problem. An algorithm is proposed for the formation of the initial set of routes for the public transport network based on the use of intermediate information on the functioning modes of the entire transport system of the city. Further steps to improve the initial set of routes using genetic algorithms are described.

articleTitle: Sharing TETRA System Resources and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Professional radiotelephone communication in System 112 can be implemented using TETRA standards equipment. We use the methods of teletraffic theory to describe the functioning of standard equipment TETRA. The system allows you to serve calls with failures or with waiting, as well as in half-duplex and duplex modes. The resource of radio channels is limited. Denial of service may occur in the aftermath of an emergency. Consider the use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in the TETRA network as a means of reducing denial of service in emergencies. The grouping of unmanned systems with repeaters on board will allow you to organize a self-organizing network, to ensure its reliable automatic operation in the event of the failure of some nodes.

articleTitle: Continuous Computing Devices for Built-In Diagnostic System of Transmit/Receive Module in Active Phased Array Radar
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Despite the high reliability of the APAR achieved through redundancy, failure and even deviation from the tolerances of the PPM parameters gradually leads to unacceptable changes in the radiation pattern of the APAR and, as a result, to a decrease in the accuracy of the radar with respect to the coordinates of the target. Periodic monitoring of the health of the elements by disabling the antenna and laborious monitoring of all emitters is necessary. There is a need to include automatic switching devices and coordination of the operating modes of the control devices and equipment for generating stimulating signals, state memory circuits controlled by the control devices, and control logic of connecting the control devices to control circuits as part of the control system. The paper discusses approaches to reducing the complexity, increasing the efficiency of the restoration of efficiency and the effectiveness of monitoring operational characteristics by integrating the integrated monitoring and diagnostics systems (IMDS) into the antenna structure.

articleTitle: Direction of Arrival Estimation Using Cyclostationary Properties of Wi-Fi Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper the DOA estimation of Wi-Fi signals is consider based on their cyclostationarity property due to the digital modulation. The cyclic autocorrelation and complementary cyclic autocorrelation characteristics are shown for various modulation types used in 802.11 a/b/g standards. The simulations and experimental investigation results are presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of the High-Orbital Satellite Reflection Spectrum Based on Materials and Coatings Laboratory Reflection Spectra
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An approach to modeling the reflection spectrum of a high-orbit artificial Earth satellite based on mixing laboratory reflection spectra of materials and coatings is presented, which allows reproducing the spectral distribution of the optical radiation reflected from the satellite in the visible range for further processing for the purpose of qualitative and quantitative interpretation of reflection spectra.

articleTitle: Digital Processing of Noisy Signals of Radio Engineering Systems with the Selection of Linear and Harmonic Components
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work is devoted to the analysis of digital methods for extracting linear and periodic components in highly noisy signals of radio engineering systems. When analyzing random data, situations often arise when it is necessary to find out whether observations or estimates of signal parameters are statistically independent or whether they are subject to a trend - a monotonic or periodic change in the properties of systems or processes. This problem acquires special significance in the analysis of non-stationary data, in which it is necessary to reliably identify the presence of a trend or identify their parameters against the background of random changes (in single measurements).

articleTitle: Fiber Optic Sensors with Polarization Multiplexing Based on Addressed Fiber Bragg Gratings
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents the concept of a microwave photonic measuring system based on addressed fiber Bragg structures with a polarization multiplexed response. Mathematical models of response of such structures have been developed, verified by computer and physical modeling. The possibility of constructing transverse load sensors that do not require the introduction of additional sensors for temperature compensation of the Bragg grating wavelength shift is shown. A device for interrogating such sensors is proposed and verified.

articleTitle: Optical Analog Nonlinear Compensation for Fiber Optic Link
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the method is proposed for compensating for distortion of signals transmitted in a fiber-optic link, based on the inclusion of an analog optical in-verse nonlinear phase filter. The proposed implementation of the restoring analog optical nonlinear phase filter. The simulation results are presented, which demonstrate the ability to compensate for nonlinear distortions and restore pulse signals in a fiber-optic transmission line using the proposed filter. It is shown that the quality of the restoration largely depends on the admissibility of the linear approximation for the exponential characteristic of the nonlinear filter.

articleTitle: Spectrum forming and detection in the system of monitoring, based on a diffraction grating
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problems of the formation and output of the measurement results of the energy spectrum of the optical signal in a spectrum analysis system based on a device with a diffraction grating and fiber-optic transmission system (FOTS) of the analyzed signals are considered. The use of FOTS allows implementing a contactless method of spectrum analysis. A mathematical model has been developed for obtaining reference values of the energy spectrum by linear CCD sensor detection. A method for correction reading results allows us to take into account the nonuniformity of the spectral sensitivity of the linear CCD sensor, the frequency response of the attenuation of the optical fiber, and also the features of the formed spectra in different diffraction orders is proposed.
