articleTitle: Some Generalization of the Theory of Generating Functions
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The author invites readers to consider some very unusual methods of calculations that he performed while solving the problem of analytic continuation of the Riemann function containing the critical strip inside of which there is an infinite set of nontrivial zeros of function by B. Rieman's hypothesis. Similar methods are used by the author when studying the properties of the generating function of Hermite polynomials with a nonnegative integer exponent.

articleTitle: Radar Portrait of a Moving Air Target Formation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the possibility of synthetic-aperture radar operation is considered not only for ground targets, but also for air ones. An analytical expression of the two-dimensional radar portrait function of a moving air target is obtained, a mathematical model of a two-dimensional radar portrait of a moving single air target, made in the Matlab environment, is presented.

articleTitle: Quartz-glass Optical Fibre Time to Fracture at Small Bending Radiuses
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Standards and specifications for optical fibres specify such parameter as “macrobending loss”, i.e. macrobends are regulated only by attenuation increase. The paper shows by means of mathematical calculation that small bending radius of optical fibre significantly reduces the time to its fracture. To ensure the smooth operation of fibre-optic communication lines it is necessary that the bending radius of the optical fibre that passed the proof-test with 1 % stain does not exceed a value equal to 62.25 mm, and for the optical fibre that passed the proof-test with 2% strain - 36.5 mm. With smaller bending radiuses, mechanical loads on optical fibres exceed the permissible values, which leads to a decrease in time to its fracture. When designing a fibre-optic communication line to predict its uninterrupted service life, it is necessary to take into account the bending radiuses to which optical fibres are subjected for a long time.

articleTitle: Design of Optical Cables Intended for Laying Inside Buildings and Zone Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of creating new designs of optical cables by testing mechanical tests to cables. To create the new designs of optical cables, observing the structures of cables is very important and by testing with machine which are intended to measure the tensile strength of cables are very useful when we compare the results of both testing and calculating with formulas for the mechanical properties of optical cables. In this paper we explain the designs of indoor and outdoor optical cables and the detailed structures are also shown with diagrams. Then, basic parameters of sample cables are presented to calculate in examples with formula of calculating area of optical cable, the modulus of elasticity of the cable and the maximum tensile force of optical cable by using the values of power element which is included in the structure of cables to prevent from external exposure.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Methods for Assessing Economic Security Indicators in the Life Cycle of On-Board Automation Systems on a Given Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A mathematical approach is presented using a unified indicator of assessing economic security in the field of creating on-board complexes of technical equipment as a payload for installation on a given technical platform, based on an assessment of the probability of various kinds of threats and the probability of their successful reflection. Various methods for estimating probabilities are presented, their capabilities and applications are revealed. It is shown that machine learning methods in combination with probabilistic programming are most suitable for the requirements of the digital economy. The analysis of the possibilities of using machine learning technologies and assessing the probability of programming in assessing and predicting economic security in the formation of onboard automation systems based on the rear platform is carried out.

Author Keywords: complexation of onboard equipment on the platform
analysis and modeling of random processes

articleTitle: The Study of the Topological Elements of the Printed Circuit Board as an Antenna when Receiving GPS Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The number of electronic and service devices using GPS/Glonass/Beidow/Galileo receiver location data is continuously increasing in the modern world. This process can be attributed to the ever-decreasing cost of the elemental base, as well as the improvement of distribution and logistics problems due to accurate knowledge of object coordinates. Mass production of receivers of global navigation systems (GNS), as well as any other electronic devices, is critical to the cost of electronic components included in it. The proposed article is devoted to the study of the possibility of replacing the antenna of GNS receivers with elements of the topology of the printed circuit board of the third-party electronic device.

articleTitle: Microstrip Filters on Codirectional Hairpin Resonators with Split Working Attenuation Poles
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we study the potential selective capabilities of various structures of microstrip filters with a limited number of half-wave codirectional hairpin resonators. It is shown that in these structures it is possible to realize a significant number of working attenuation poles at finite frequencies. The mechanisms of the attenuation poles formation, splitting and joining are studied to ensure the required attenuation level in the specified stopbands.

articleTitle: Multi-Beam Trifocal Waveguide Slot Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Three-floor two-mirror trifocal multi-beam planar waveguide slot antenna array and two-floor mirror-lens one are synthesized and researched. The aberrations of antenna arrays minimized for the 80 degrees angle of view and the characteristics of beam scanning when the feed element moves along the focal curve are studied. The comparison between bifocal and trifocal antenna arrays is discussed.

articleTitle: Recommendations for the Drift Thermal Compensation of the Oscillator Frequency Using a Dielectric Resonator
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents recommendations for reducing the frequency temperature shifts in oscillators formed by an active structure that forms a source of microwave oscillations, which is controlled by the high-quality open dielectric resonator in the feedback loop. The advantages and disadvantages of various options for implementation of temperature compensators for frequency shifts on the example of the frequency band 8–12 GHz transistor oscillator with dielectric resonator are considered and evaluated.

articleTitle: Analysis of Distortions in the De-ramped LFM-CW Signal of an Extended Target
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Purpose. Analysis of distortions in the de-ramped linear frequency modulated continuous wave (LFM-CW) signal reflected from an extended target (ET), which model is presented by a set of point scatterers. Definition of parameters affecting distortions in the de-ramped signal spectrum, and development of ET radar profile restoration methods. Methodology. Numeric computations method based on the equation describing the de-ramped LFM-CW signal of an ET. The de-ramped signal properties analysis by means of numeric computation with varying values of properties of the probing signal and the ET. Findings. Parameters of the transmitted signal and the ET model that affect the distortions have been determined: starting frequency, frequency change rate, the ET relative height, the distance between the reflectors, the limits of phase noise values. The spectrum distortion index has been introduced. Value. ET radar profile restoration methods that can be used for signal processing have been developed.

articleTitle: Use of Flexible Payloads for Russian Communication and Broadcast Satellites
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article analyzes the global trends in satellite communications and broadcasting and discusses the use of Flexible payloads using multi-beam antennas with electronic forming of service areas for communication and broadcasting satellites in Russia. This approach allows you to use the satellite for almost any orbital position and to provide redundancy of companions in orbit in case of their failure. Satellites using multibeam antennas with electronic forming of service areas can be manufactured practically in series, and not for a specific orbital position.

articleTitle: Scan Blindness in Finite Microstrip Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work considers the problem of scan blindness in microstrip antenna arrays and shows the relationship between the results of analysis carried out with the assumption of infinite antenna array and the results for finite antenna array. The results for infinite arrays obtained using the concept of Floquet modes can be used jointly with empirical results for finite antenna arrays to obtain a method to optimize the parameters of dielectric substrate and the distance between radiating elements to get a scan sector with required scan loss.

articleTitle: Automation of the Learning Process of a Neural Network as Classifier in the Formation of a Design Basis of Complex Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The method of the automation of the learning process of a neural network as classifier is considered in this paper. This method is based on using the developed algorithm and programs that automatically generate training examples. For this purpose, the methodology of planning a full factorial experiment is used. The classifier is software complex, which includes: a database, a multilayer perceptron, as well as a block of programs providing automatic learning of perceptron. Application neural network as classifier with automated learning allows significantly reduce time spent on the formation of a constructive basis for complex transport systems.

articleTitle: Detection of Small-Sized Radar Objects Using Multi-Scanning Observation Method
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper we consider a surveillance radar with an additional multi-scanning observation device. In each channel of the multi-scanning observation device the well- known procedure “track-before-detect” is implemented. Combined processing of the results of several scannings is based on Hough transform. In conditions of high probability of false alarms due to the low threshold of primary detection, an excessive number of potential candidate tracks is formed. We analyse the functioning of the device for these conditions, assume variants of signal processing of several space scannings and estimate their efficiency.

articleTitle: Accelerated Evaluation of Spread Spectrum Signals Synchronization Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: For satellite radio navigation systems, an accelerated digital algorithm for estimating the synchronization parameters of spread spectrum signals is considered: time delay, carrier frequency, and initial frequency phase. Signals of both a traditional structure and signals on non-harmonic subcarriers - binary, which corresponds to BOC (binary offset carrier modulated) signals, and multi-position, i.e. MOC (multi position offset carrier modulated) signals are considered. The novelty of the developed approach is the use of an accelerated algorithm for calculating the cross section of the real part of the uncertainty function of a spread spectrum signal along the time axis, taking into account the structure of the used pseudorandom sequence using the generalized fast Fourier transform. It is shown that the accuracy of time synchronization is significantly increased in the case of MOC-signals, due to weaker fluctuations of the real part of their autocovariance functions in the region of the main peak, in comparison with the other types of signals considered.

Author Keywords: MOC (multi position offset carrier modulated)- signals

articleTitle: The Application of the Joint Range and Speed Estimation Method in Short-Range Radars Using Ultra-Wideband Signals with a Pseudo-Random Frequency Coding
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article uses the previously presented method [1] of joint estimation of range and radial velocity in short-range radars using one ultra-wideband signal with discrete frequency coded waveform (DFCW). The core of the method is the use of the expression of the two-dimensional digital compression function of the output of the radar receiver ADC. The results of the practical implementation of this method are presented in a radar with a generation circuit using a phase-locked loop (PLL) generator, direct digital synthesis generator (DDS) and a quadrature modulator (IQ modulator). The results of the method are compared for signals with linear and pseudo-random frequency codes. The results of the method after using the calibration algorithm are presented

articleTitle: Providing QOS for OTT Services in Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the main models that contribute to improving the quality of OTT services. The main parameter for quality assessment was chosenQoE-Quality of Experience. An analysis was made of a number of factors that directly affect the assessment of QoE. The second part of the article deals with models that can provide the necessary level of quality for OTT services. These models were divided into three groups: traffic-based models, application-based models, and speed-based models. The main task of the study is to find optimal solutions to ensure the quality of OTT services.

articleTitle: Ray Methods and Special Functions of Wave Catastrophes
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: New asymptotic methods for solving problems of diffraction, focusing and propagation of electromagnetic waves in inhomogeneous anisotropic media are considered: the bicharacteristic method and the wave catastrophe theory. Hamilton-Lukin's bicharacteristic method was used to perform mathematical modeling of ray and caustic structures arising from the propagation of radio waves in the Earth's ionosphere. The results of mathematical modeling of caustic sections of the main, edge and corner wave catastrophes are given. Uniform asymptotic solutions of wave problems leading to special functions of wave catastrophes are considered, and amplitude-phase structures of wave catastrophe special functions are presented.

articleTitle: Electronic warfare as a task of maintaining homeostasis in an information conflict
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The basic properties of electronic systems involved in electronic warfare are revealed. Based on the analysis of these properties, it is proposed to consider electronic warfare as the task of maintaining homeostasis in an information conflict. The systematic approach developed as part of the task is based on the analysis of the conflict interaction of developing information systems (IS). Each of the IS in relation to the other participant in the conflict plays the role of the external environment. Based on this approach, the basic principles and rules of building developing IS are formulated. The determining factors in assessing the effectiveness of such systems are the adopted concept and strategies for their functioning. In a generalized form, the optimal concept of the functioning of IS is reduced to resolving the conflict of IS with the external environment in their favor while maintaining the ability to develop. This allows you to avoid fundamental (gross) errors in the formation of the concept of design information systems and correctly evaluate their effectiveness with minimal cost.

articleTitle: Method for Estimating the SFN Stability Reserve
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The method of assessing the stability reserve of SFN networks and the device for its implementation, including a bit error sensor and multichannel diagnostic receiver is considered. Definitions and quantitative assessment of stability stock and stability threshold in digital television networks are given. The recommendations formulated in the article will allow estimating the reserves of stability of SFN networks, to identify and eliminate the causes of technical faults in broadcasting, to move to parametric optimization of SFN, providing a given speed of data transmission and maximum stability reserve

articleTitle: Maneuvering Reentry Target Tracking by Means of Passive Radar
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A reentry target tracking problem is considered by means of passive antenna array. The target is thought to constantly emit a signal with known frequency so Doppler frequency measurements are available. IMM algorithm is proposed to take account of variable target dynamics. Several sets of EKF filters which include both MaRV and BRV dynamic models were compared through RMSE of the target position and velocity. Additionally, three linearization techniques were considered showing different accuracy and computational complexity.

articleTitle: Leaky Wave Antennas with Wide Sector of Frequency Scanning and a Fixed Beam
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Leaky-wave antennas radiating at zero and −1 spatial harmonics are considered. The analytical theory of synthesis for an antenna having a semi-transparent wall made of metal cylinders with a given distribution of radiated power along the antenna is developed. Waveguide-slot antennas with four longitudinal and three transverse slots per period are proposed and investigated. The possibilities of frequency scanning in the angular sector of 180 degrees are shown. A leaky-wave antenna with a waveguide prism and a fixed beam in a wide frequency band is studied.

articleTitle: Interoperability Application Package
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To simplify the solution of the problem of ensuring the ability to interact with ready-made software systems, the paper considers the creation of a set of interconnected modules as tool software. When developing a set of interconnected modules to ensure interaction between software systems at the physical level, it is proposed to use CALS technologies, at a logical level, a program for frequency data identification. The developed modules allow to reduce the time needed to create a single data warehouse using PDM technology and to ensure the interaction of software systems using standard CALS interfaces and a frequency data identification program.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Filtering Algorithm for Echo Signal Interference Suppression in Single Carrier Duplex Satellite Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A high performance algorithm is proposed to provide efficient separation of transmission paths in single carrier duplex satellite systems. The algorithm is based on direct estimation of Wiener-Hopf equation solution on each iteration in real-time. Several approximations and fast calculation techniques are implemented to reduce computational complexity of the algorithm proposed. In particular, the algorithm uses predefined autocorrelation matrix, fast procedure of cross-correlation vector calculation and fast procedure of Toeplitz matrix multiplication by vector. The approximation of cross-correlation vectors array is also implemented. Algorithm efficiency is been studied on simplified model of earth stations and satellite. The study results demonstrate that the algorithm provides echo interference suppression more than 40 dB in typical for bandwidth optimization techniques conditions and allows to use QAM modulation with 256 levels. The proposed algorithm was compared for robustness with other commonly used adaptive filtering algorithms, such as: conventional RLS, QR-decomposition RLS, Householder RLS, NLMS, frequency domain LMS and affine projection algorithm. In considered application, the proposed algorithm outperforms other algorithms in terms of echo interference suppression.

articleTitle: Interrogator for Vibration and Shape Mode Sensing Using an Address Fiber Bragg Grating Array
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work presents a concept of interrogator design for microwave-photonic sensor system (MWPSS) for real-time distributed acoustic sensing measurement of vibrations (dynamic mode) and shape (quazi-static mode) in intellectual transport means, for example, wings of aircrafts or truck tires. The proposed MWPSS is based on the addressed fiber Bragg structures (AFBSs), consisting from two symmetrical ultra-narrow fiber Bragg gratings (2λ-FBG) each. Ultra-narrow FBGs have common middle wavelength, equal bandwidths and unique address frequency spacing between them, thus realizing the microwave-photonic interrogation method by means of beating signal detection on address frequencies. This multiplicative optical response analysis allows to define the middle Bragg wavelengths shift of each AFBS in array and to correlate it with the value of the influencing physical fields (vibration and shape deformation). These values of interrogator are input parameters for MWPSS.

articleTitle: Highly Selective Microstrip Filters Based on Multi-Step Comb Structures with Additional Cross-Coupling
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we study the selective capabilities of highly selective three- and four-resonator microstrip filters based on multi-step comb structures with additional electromagnetic cross-coupling between non-adjacent resonators. The effect of impedance steps in different parts of the length of the resonators on the working attenuation poles formation and their location on the frequency axis is shown. The possibilities of various methods for controlling the degree of the splitting of the attenuation poles and their location relative to the passband are demonstrated.

articleTitle: The Concept of Program-Modeling Complex in order to Create a System of Anti-Jamming Satellite Communications Systems (Radio Links to “Earth-Spacecraft”)
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work examines the construction of program-modeling complex (PMC) in relation Fto the establishment and operation of an integrated system of anti-jamming (ISA) of the radio links of the “Earth-spacecraft”. ISA consists of a broadband communication system (based on signals from the RF and noise-resistant codes) and a system of spatial filtering of signals (based on a multi-beam antenna and adaptive noise compensators. The methodology of construction of PMK on the basis of the maximum strategy of decision-making is given

Author Keywords: system of a spatial filtration of signals

articleTitle: Object Tracking Algorithm Based on the Harris Detector
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of prototype hardware and software for the automatic tracking of the object based on the Harris detector. An original algorithm is invariant to distortion of the form “zooming”, “picture rotation <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\prime\prime$</tex>, “illumination scene change”, and software implementation of the algorithm. The experimental results of the study.

Author Keywords: the implementation of the classification algorithm

articleTitle: Resampling in Audio Broadcast Formation Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The issues of minimizing the resampling distortions in the sound transmission signal transmission channels are considered. The main reasons for the appearance of distortions of the real signal when changing the sampling frequency are shown, a method for reducing these distortions is proposed. The results of the estimation of distortions in the transmission of a real signal are presented.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of Methods for Reducing the Noise Temperature of Axisymmetric Reflector Antennas of Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: the developed methods for reducing the noise temperature of axisymmetric reflector antennas of satellite communications have shown the possibility of increasing the signal-to-noise ratio of received signals. To confirm the theoretical calculations, experiments were carried out that confirmed the calculated values of increasing the signal-to-noise ratio of the received signals. The developed methods for reducing the noise temperature of reflector antennas can only be used for axisymmetric satellite dish reflectors receiving signals from relay satellites in geostationary orbit.

articleTitle: Influence of Node Reliability on Data Exchange Efficiency in Distributed Monitoring Systems with Dynamic Topology
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Dynamic routing protocols transmit routing information in a finite time, resulting in errors in determining the optimal packet route. As a consequence, the efficiency of data exchange may deteriorate, for example, increasing the time spent on the network packets. The aim of the work is to study the behavior of the network in the case of unpredictable topology changes caused by sudden multiple failures of network equipment. The solution is carried out with the help of a specialized simulation model that allows you to track the change in network parameters in the process of its operation. Simulation showed that equipment failures lead to a qualitatively new network behavior, for the characteristics of which, along with the traditional indicator “packet delivery time”, two characteristics are additionally defined: “the proportion of lost packets” and “the probability of packet looping”. A comparative analysis of several variants of the implementation of routing algorithms using multi-step and one-step metrics is performed and the conditions for choosing the optimal parameters of routing process control are determined. The results of the research allow us to determine the requirements for the speed of transmission of route information, characteristics of route labels and access control parameters depending on the network topology.

articleTitle: Verification of Cryptographic Algorithms Based on the Use of Method Simulation Binary Random Sequences with Specified Statistical Properties
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of obtaining a set of samples to evaluate the quality of cryptographic algorithms through the use of statistical tests. Describes new features of binary Markov chains, taking into account the dependence of the probability of binary vectors of different lengths. The analytical expressions for the limits calculated according to ranges of values of binary probabilities of multidimensional random variables on the probability of binary random variables smaller dimension. The reasons of the need for additional “reject” procedure in the simulation implementations binary Markov processes. The method of directed enumeration values of probability distributions Markov ranks binary sequences, allowing to generate ergodic random binary sequence that allows you to completely abandon the “rejection” procedure. Presented algorithm implementing said method having reduced computational complexity compared to known algorithms Computing experiment to study the statistical properties of random binary sequences.

articleTitle: Achievable Error Levels of the Goniometric Location of Radiation Sources Based on the Least Squares Method with an Increase of the Amount of Information Processed
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the effect of an increase in the volume of direction-finding information used on error levels of locating radiation sources using the goniometric location method as applied to aerial reconnaissance based on a single aircraft carrier is considered. The approach to assessing the capabilities of the direction finding method adopted in this paper is based on the analysis of the goniometric location algorithm optimized by the least squares criterion using computer simulation methods. The problem of locating radiation sources on a plane is considered in relation to scenarios of practical interest. The above results indicate significant opportunities to improve the accuracy of the goniometric method of passive radar, implemented by a single direction finding, placed on a mobile air carrier, by increasing the amount of processed direction finding information (the number of bearings) and the shape of the flight path.

articleTitle: Radio Frequency Identification Using Reader Based on a Multi-Port Junction
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A new approach to design and development of RFID reader based on a multi-port reflectometer is suggested in the paper. The possibility of reader operation (read/write) range increase using this approach is shown. The pivot element of the proposed reader is the combined multi-port reflectometer, which can be used in two possible configurations. The first configuration implies the measurement of output ports' powers, rather than alternative configuration consists in use of subsequent down conversion unit of the measuring frequency. An important feature of the proposed calibration procedure is the lack of precision calibration standards for reflection or transmission that simplifies and cheapens the meter drastically. The CMR design is described and the measuring method is considered. The simulation results of measurement and calibration processes for the described meter are presented, which confirmed the high efficiency of its use as a reader in RFID systems.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Probbability of One Type of Errors in Digital Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper investigates the probability of errors in the damage of the information block whereby a combination of characters appears in the block corresponding to another transmitted information block. In this paper, we used the example of Reed-Solomon error-correcting coding by two different methods. Results showed that the probability of such errors is negligible.

articleTitle: Optimal Balance of Telecommunication System Resource in Case of Information Technology Impacts
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: With use Cobb-Douglas ratio the balance of information resource of telecommunication system was to achieve target function and to ensure the security of information under conditions of additive information technology impacts justified. Information conflict of components of the protected system with means of destructive effects is reproduced in the form of implementation of the conflict component in its information area during joint operation. The process of protecting telecommunication system is on changing the private target functions of the components to prevent penetration and implement the conflict component in the information area based. Safe state of the system is by results of maximization of probability of realization of its target function at set parameters of cycles and limitations on control resources determined. An iterative procedure for evaluating the change of the target function of the system and resource consumption for neutralization of the conflict component has been built.

articleTitle: Adaptive Compensation for Interference under Radio Signals Reception by the Multibeam Antenna System
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The concept of organizing interference compensation when receiving a radio signal by the multipath antenna system is considered. Methods for improving the quality of radio signal reception in a complex interference environment with the definition of a promising method for use are considered and analyzed. Schemes for constructing a dish antenna system of a compensation antenna with the development of recommendations for construction are considered and analyzed. Variants of technical solutions for creating a broadband antenna feed are considered, an analysis of the results is carried out, and proposals for further research are formulated.

articleTitle: On Automated Safety Distance Monitoring Methods by Stereo Cameras
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the idea of processing the object of observation using stereo vision systems is advanced. Stereoscopic vision is the direction of machine vision that allows you to create a three-dimensional picture of the world around you. In laboratories around the world, practical research is being conducted on the use of stereo vision for solving applied problems. Stereoscopic vision repeats the capabilities of the human eye, allowing you to get not only color and brightness from the input image, but also the distance to it. This technology will allow you to do without expensive equipment, sensors, radars for monitoring traffic and fixing violations.

articleTitle: Conjunction and synchronization methods of earth satellite images with local cartographic data
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The tools for processing satellite images and orientation objects with maximum accuracy based on local cartographic data are considered. A brief description of the process of obtaining digital images, preliminary procedures for processing images, as well as the process of detection and recognition of objects in the image. The results of working with interactive maps, as well as completed and approved projects based on the services OpenStreetMap, Yandex. Maps and Google Earth, are described. A brief overview of interactive maps of the area and their views, including interactive maps with visualization, is given. The most popular services with interactive maps of the area, their types and applications are also considered. The technique of processing satellite images with their subsequent placement in cartographic services is presented. Fragments of individual projects for editing interactive maps for various types of areas are also presented. Orientation problems with maximum accuracy are described using the services OpenStreetMap, Yandex.Maps and Google Earth, and the features of using interactive maps for various categories of users.

articleTitle: Testing, Verification and Validation of Distributed Ledger Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Improving the quality of software that implements distributed ledger systems based on blockchain technology is an urgent task for the transport industry. In this article, we will look at tools to improve quality such as testing, validation, and validation. The paper lists a number of existing tools for testing and verifying blockchain systems and smart contracts, and also identifies the problem of the lack of an appropriate normative base and standards in this area.

articleTitle: Features of Capacity of Communication Channel with APSK-N signals, which Implements the Theory of Resolution Time
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper analyzes the features that arise in the process of information transmition using a multi-position amplitude-phase-shift signal with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> discrete states through a nonparametric, frequency-selective communication channel with intersymbol interference. We consider a class of channels utilizing the theory of resolution time. The greatest attention is paid to a study of properties of “transparency windows” in the presence of adverse factors such as frequency detuning and envelope and phase measurement errors introduced by the receiving device. Due to the obtained results recommendations are made to increase the speed in such communication channels.

articleTitle: Possible Applications of Sixth Generation Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Our future society will be increasingly digitized and globally data-driven. Mobile communications technologies like 5Gwhile evolving make our daily lives easier and safer, as well as significantly impact on business efficiency. But we start thinking about the next steps - 6G networks. It is not yet clear what the advent of sixth-generation networks will entail. Perhaps thanks to high-resolution visualization and recognition, wearable displays, mobile robots and drones, completely new services such as telepresence and extended reality will be possible. The main issue of the studies is the transfer of data with a rate of up to 1 Tbit/s per user. This may become possible thanks to the efficient use of the spectrum in the THz domain. Another important issue will be using and implementing smart technologies, different type data sources, artificial intelligence and remote (tele-) presence that raise many technical and mathematical problems on the road toward 6G. For these reasons, 6G networks are a huge area for research. This article presents the possible services and involved technologies of the 6G network and its possible features. The following are system-wide trends that will define goals for 6G. In conclusion, a key way-points and research program are suggested.

articleTitle: Approach to Estimating the Probability of Providing “Cloud” Services in the SDN
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The subject of the study is “cloud” services that are provided to customers in software-defined networks. The purpose of the work is to offer mathematical software for calculating the channel resource when implementing a “cloud” service at the client's request and assess the possibility of providing it, taking into account the specifics of software-defined networks. The methodological basis of the work is made up of methods of theoretical analysis, mathematical modeling and method of generalization. The mathematical model is based on a proven method of sifted load for a multiservice network. Mathematical modeling was carried out for a generalized network structure using the MATLAB mathematical package. The results were obtained for the most frequently used number of channel units (from 1 to 10) and different network load, which makes it possible to put the proposed method into practice. Based on the results of an experimental study, conclusions and recommendations are made.

articleTitle: Monitoring Anomalous States of Computer Systems by Intellectual Analysis of Data of System Journals
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The ways and algorithms for automating the control of computer systems by intelligently analyzing unstructured data from system logs in order to detect and diagnose abnormal states are analyzed. This information is needed by the technical support service to localize the problem and accurately diagnose it. Because of the ever-increasing size of logs, intelligent analysis data models are being used to help developers extract system information. The research was conducted on a network infrastructure consisting of 6 hosts that make up a cluster under Rancher management. Expertly, events that significantly affect the system and are abnormal, related to problems with the passage of traffic on the network, or denial of service. Of the 988 message templates, 81 patterns are marked as abnormal.

articleTitle: The New Neural Network Based Framework for Fading Channel Prediction for 5G
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents a developed framework based on several neural networks with fine tuning for predicting CQI based on the time series of SINR values in order to select the best MCS on the eNB side, taking into account fading in the radio channel in downlink. A comparative analysis of the performance of modern architectures in solving the problem of forecasting time series and substantiating the choice of LSTM as the core of the predictive framework is performed. A comparative analysis of the learning algorithms of the architectures under consideration is performed. The choice of the model is justified and the performance evaluation of the developed framework is given. The choice of parameters of the developed predictive framework is justified.

articleTitle: Measurement of Optical Spectrum by a Spectral Device Based on an Acousto-Optic Tunable Filter with a Stepwise Tuning Frequency
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The role of spectral measurements in science and technology is noted. The measurement of optical spectra by an idealized spectral device based on an acousto-optic tunable filter is considered. It is shown that the acousto-optical methods of spectral measurements can be considered as a manifestation of the bilinear property of acousto-optical interaction. In this context, the transition to linear integral operators describing the measurement of the spectra of radio and optical signals is made. An analysis is given of the procedure for measuring the optical spectrum with a spectral device based on an acousto-optic tunable filter with an abrupt change in the frequency of the control signal. The comprehensive characteristic of such a device, its complex spread function, as well as the result of measuring the optical spectrum in the form of an energy spectrum, has been established.

Author Keywords: spectral device based on acousto-optic tunable filter

articleTitle: Calculation of Total Electron Content for Simulation of Meteor-Scatter Radio Links
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Channel nonreciprocity is one of understudied features of meteor-scatter radio propagation that is caused mainly by polarization phenomena in the channel. For correct estimation of the nonreciprocity level, accurate values of the Faraday polarization twist are required that leads to problem of calculation of Total Electron Content of the ionosphere (TEC) along the signal propagation path. In this paper, the TEC is calculated by direct numerical integration of the ionosphere electron density throughout uplink to a meteor trail. The calculation method is based on division of the uplink path into several segments, each characterized by its own electron density height profile. Our computations made for 10000 various meteor trails simulated for a typical meteor radio link of 720-km length showed quite unambiguously that precise integration along the propagation path can be replaced with high accuracy by simple integration over the single electron height profile containing the signal reflection point. Estimates of the difference between the TEC values calculated for the opposite propagation uplink paths to meteor trail from both link ends are presented. It is shown that these differences are tiny and can be neglected at modeling meteor-scatter links.

articleTitle: Review Methods for Calculating the Path Losses in a Closed Trans-Horizon Radio Link
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents 2 methods for calculating the losses in the propagation of the radio signal of the tropospheric horizontal line. The key topic is the consideration and comparison of the described methods in Russian literature by scientists V.V.Serov and V.I.Shloma and comparing them with the ITU international recommendation calculations. The presented calculations are valid for propagation paths of a radio signal with frequencies from 30 MHz and for distances up to 700 km. The article mentions the main signal transmission mechanisms used through the troposphere.

articleTitle: Methods of Detecting Latent Defects in Cells of the Super-Operative Memory of Microcircuits Used in the Digital Signal Processing Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article reveals the reasons for the low efficiency of modern methods for detecting latent defects in the chips of super operative memory (further, memory chips) used in digital signal processing systems. The first reason is due to the constant decline in technological design standards. The second reason is that modern systems of functional testing the memory chips are not able to detect latent defects in the chips in real time. As a third reason, we can point out the insufficient effectiveness of modern “marching” tests, which are widely used for testing memory chips. In this paper, we propose a complex approach to organizing memory chips testing. The main idea this approach is supporting a close relationship is maintained between the mathematical and topological models of the tested chip. It is this connection that eliminates the first two of the above reasons for the low efficiency of memory chips testing methods. The hardware-software complex, that implements this approach, ensures the maintenance of a unified information environment based on the original hardware-oriented programming language STeeL. To eliminate the third reason mentioned above, a special component “Memory” was implemented as part of complex, which, unlike the well-known implementations, allows you to create functional tests of any complexity. This component implements the version of the “marching” test, which is a short dynamic memory test based on statistics from previous tests. The latter circumstance significantly reduces the total time spent on testing chips.

articleTitle: Predictability Assess of Multipath Phase Using ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Physical Layer Security is a promising technique for establishing a secret encryption key in wireless communications. The secret key is distilled from the Channel State Information under conditions of its random fast fading. However, random channel variations are quite smooth on short-term intervals and can be predicted using previous samples. This is a serious threat to secrecy of the generated encryption key. In this study, we assess both prediction error and prediction horizon for real data set of a fast fading carrier phase using the ARIMA model. Influence of the autoregressive model order on the prediction accuracy is considered, optimum ARIMA parameters for forecasting the experimental data are found. We also compare prediction accuracy of the ARIMA that uses fixed model parameters versus accuracy of the auto-ARIMA that employs adaptive estimation of model parameters in different timeframes of the data. Our results showed that effective prediction of real samples of multipath phase was possible only at intervals shorter than 150 ms, and maximum prediction gain did not exceed 40 degrees compared to prediction based on the last known sample.
